title: Every news story hides a static topic
sources: UPSC Civil Services Examination notice: Prelims GS Paper I syllabus

quiz.q: A wetland is in the news as a new Ramsar site. Which static fact is most worth checking?
quiz.why: Right. Prelims usually asks about the convention: Ramsar, Iran, 1971.

review.note: Written and voiced by Claude (AI voices, Kokoro), 8 Nov 2026. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor. Method piece; the only fact is the Ramsar Convention (1971, Ramsar, Iran).

lines.say: Current affairs feels endless. How do you prepare for it?
By treating every news story as a doorway to a topic you already study.
